info.title: Frankfurter API
info.description: Frankfurter is an open-source API for current and historical foreign exchange rates, sourcing currency data from public providers like the European Central Bank.

tags.description: Historical exchange rates for specific dates and periods

get.description: Returns historical rates for every day within a time period starting from the provided date until today.
